title: President Trump Makes an Announcement on Healthcare Affordability, Aug. 31, 2026
transcript: Thank you very much, President Trump, for your leadership.
shows: RFK Jr. standing beside the Resolute Desk addressing the room of pharma executives; Trump seated, listening, eyes still open.

title: President Trump Makes an Announcement on Healthcare Affordability, Aug. 31, 2026
transcript: And, uh, it's all thanks to you, because nobody thought that this was possible.
shows: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick gesturing mid-praise beside the desk while Trump sits with eyes heavy-lidded/closed, head tilted down.

title: President Trump Makes an Announcement on Healthcare Affordability, Aug. 31, 2026
transcript: Thank you, Howard. And you know, just uh, the enthusiasm, you know, you hear these three guys. I hear them all the time.
shows: Trump answering right after the eyes-closed stretch, eyes open again but visibly re-orienting, rambling slightly.

title: President Trump Makes an Announcement on Healthcare Affordability, Aug. 31, 2026
shows: Close-ish shot of Trump at the Resolute Desk, eyes fully closed, head drooping forward, while aides stand behind him; the head-tilt/eyes-closing moment itself.
